content.text:
Compliance **got worse** over the window from 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12. The whole decline comes from `screen_lock`, which went from 0 failing devices on the first day to 5 on the last day. The other two checks stayed the same.

**Evidence**
- **screen_lock (medium severity):** 0 failing devices on the first day and 5 on the last. All 5 passed at first, then started failing and have failed every day since:
  - 1LYSSFD074BB: failing since 2026-05-22, 22 snapshots in a row [compliance_drift/1LYSSFD074BB/screen_lock, 1LYSSFD074BB/2026-05-21, 1LYSSFD074BB/2026-05-22]
  - MT7PJB7N5LRE: failing since 2026-05-28, 16 snapshots [compliance_drift/MT7PJB7N5LRE/screen_lock, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-05-27, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-05-28]
  - 8NM23J95R5I6: failing since 2026-05-30, 14 snapshots [compliance_drift/8NM23J95R5I6/screen_lock, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-05-29, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-05-30]
  - DLT35MHGTH2D: failing since 2026-06-01, 12 snapshots [compliance_drift/DLT35MHGTH2D/screen_lock, DLT35MHGTH2D/2026-05-31, DLT35MHGTH2D/2026-06-01]
  - DSYPSES7SKBB: failing since 2026-06-01, 12 snapshots [compliance_drift/DSYPSES7SKBB/screen_lock, DSYPSES7SKBB/2026-05-31, DSYPSES7SKBB/2026-06-01]
- **os_up_to_date (medium severity):** 9 failing devices on both the first and last day, so no change. It's still the most widespread problem: 9 of 10 devices fail it today [1LYSSFD074BB/2026-06-12, 7VP16KHV88LM/2026-06-12, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12, 9MXJVZ1I0DKA/2026-06-12, DSYPSES7SKBB/2026-06-12, M4XVHUV1MEPZ/2026-06-12, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12, Q3VUITEGQ400/2026-06-12, XSU9UUDGU6AC/2026-06-12].
- **disk_encryption (high severity):** 0 failing devices on both days. All 10 devices pass.

**Caveats**
- "Better or worse" here only compares the number of failing devices on the first and last day of the window. The compliance tool doesn't give a daily count for the whole fleet, so I can't show the full curve. The drift findings show the `screen_lock` failures appearing one by one between 2026-05-22 and 2026-06-01.
- The drift detector only flags checks that went from passing to failing. The 9 `os_up_to_date` failures were already there when the window started, so they don't show up as drift.
- The first-day and last-day counts come straight from the compliance tool, which doesn't attach snapshot ids to them. The citations above point to the underlying device snapshots and findings.
